t2.thesis: SNAP goes into a high-variance (~14% implied) Q3 print with depressed sentiment and a cheap multiple, but sector peers have just been punished on soft outlooks, so the outcome is close to a coin flip around the base rate.
reasons: Base rate for software_internet/AMC buy-everything is about 54%.
Expectations look washed out: down 8% in 5 days, 38% below the 52w high, forward P/E ~7, and P/S ~1.5. That cushions a modest beat or in-line guide.
Estimates have been revised up over 90 days (quarter EPS moved from -0.004 to +0.003) and SNAP beat EPS in each of the last four prints. Still, only 2 of those 4 reactions were positive.
Peer read-through is negative: Reddit fell 25% on a soft outlook despite a beat, and SNAP itself fell 5% that day (I19). The 10-Q also flags slowing ad demand and competition.
Options pricing (call IV above put IV, low put/call volume) leans mildly bullish, but it is a weak signal and mostly reflects positioning.
t2.deciding_variable: The Q4 revenue/adjusted EBITDA guidance versus consensus, together with the trend in North America ad demand and DAUs.

prior.from: I3 by_cluster software_internet t0_hit 0.541 (SNAP is a social/ad-internet name), cross-checked with AMC session 0.538 and overall ~0.542

t2.leak_probe: I don't know: that earnings report is dated November 4, 2026, which is after today (November 3, 2026) and after my knowledge cutoff, so the stock's reaction hasn't happened yet.
t2.moved_from_prior: Net about -1pp from 0.54. Low expectations and the upward EPS revisions add roughly +1pp. The negative peer read-through (Reddit, soft guidance across the ad-internet group), North America DAU decline and slowing ad demand subtract roughly -2pp. The legal settlement news is mostly priced in and has negligible effect.

theses.mechanism: Revenue grows in the high teens, EBITDA beats and the Q4 guide is solid, so a heavily discounted stock squeezes higher, as after the Q2 print (+11.5%).
theses.wrong_if: The Q4 revenue guide midpoint lands below consensus or the guide flags ad-demand softness.

theses.mechanism: Q4 guidance is cautious (holiday ad spend, platform/policy headwinds, competition) and NA DAUs keep shrinking, so the stock re-rates down like Reddit and SNAP's own May print.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance is in line or better and management highlights accelerating direct revenue and subscriptions.

theses.mechanism: Mixed results (beat on EBITDA, light DAUs) are offset by the low valuation, so the move stays well inside the 14% implied move and is driven by noise.
theses.wrong_if: Either the guide or a capital return/buyback announcement surprises materially.

key_observations: Q4 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance versus consensus
North America and Europe DAU trends; whether global DAUs stay near or above 493M
Q3 revenue growth versus the 19% in Q2, and ad revenue growth versus other/direct revenue
Free cash flow and any buyback or capital return update
Commentary on legal settlements, platform policy impacts and Specs spending
